Row.Text: Common Specialists Yields
Always show negative yields
Show negative yield differences on every tile. When off, they only appear on the tile under the cursor.
Show original yields by default
Keep the unmodified game display, and show the common-yield view only while Shift is held. When off, the mod's view is the default and Shift shows the original one.
Do not aggregate negative yields

Leave costs out of the common value on the map, so every tile keeps showing its full negative yields instead of only the difference. The panel still lists them. Where the full figures are shown — the tile under the cursor — a yield's gain and its upkeep also stay apart instead of being added together.
Show only yields with a common value
Hide yield types with no common value from the Common Yields panels, leaving only the ones specialists actually affect.
Show everything on hover

While hovering a tile, show its complete yields instead of the difference from the common value. A yield's gain and its upkeep are added together, so each one appears as a single number. Only the hovered tile is affected.
Do not aggregate positive yields
Leave gains out of the common value on the map, so every tile shows its full positive yields even when they are the same everywhere. The panel still lists them.

Show only tiles giving the most Influence

Shows only the tile where a specialist would give the most of that yield, and hides the yield numbers on every other tile. Tiles tied for the best are all shown. Several of these can be on at once - a tile is shown if it wins any of them. The tile under the cursor always keeps its numbers.
